primary_context_sequence.summary: The gods' speech celebrates that Osiris stands up.
The gate of heaven and the gate of the heavenly waters are opened.
A way is prepared so that the recipient can come forth with the gods, living as his Ba.
The recipient is declared not truly dead but truly revived among the imperishable Akhs.
The inundation season arrives and an efflux from Osiris is distributed.
Horus is purified from what Seth did to him; Seth is purified from what Horus did to him; Pepi is purified from evil; the Horus-associated watchers are purified when Horus embraces his father Osiris.
A divine/royal appearance on the lake and throne follows in the surviving sequence.

reverse_result.compressed: OSIRIS_STANDS -> GATES_OPEN -> PATH_OUT -> BA_LIVES -> NOT_DEAD_BUT_REVIVED -> OSIRIAN_EFFLUX -> HORUS_SETH_MUTUAL_CLEANUP -> HORUS_EMBRACES_OSIRIS -> THRONE/APPEARANCE
reverse_result.why_important: The previous search treated mutual Horus/Seth damage-cleanup and Osirian restoration as separate witnesses. PT 667A places them inside one textual composition and one ritual sequence.

horus_seth_semantics.textual_fact: PT 667A symmetrically purifies Horus from Seth's act and Seth from Horus's act.

osiris_bridge.textual_fact: The same PT 667A sequence contains Osiris standing, revival language, Osirian efflux and Horus embracing his father Osiris.

important_correction_to_prior_summary.old_simplification: PT667A = mutual Horus/Seth cleanup then return to Osiris
important_correction_to_prior_summary.new_reading: PT667A is a broader ascension/revivification composition in which Osirian rising, gate-opening, Ba-life, revival, Osirian efflux, mutual Horus/Seth purification and Horus-to-Osiris embrace are all co-located.

canonical_lines: PT 667A DOES MORE THAN CLEAN UP A QUARREL: IT HOLDS REVIVAL, PASSAGE, BA-LIFE, OSIRIAN EFFLUX, MUTUAL PURIFICATION AND FILIAL RECONNECTION IN ONE RITUAL CONTAINER.
THE BRIDGE IS NOW TEXTUAL; THE CAUSAL CLAIM REMAINS OPEN.
CLEAN BOTH SIDES OF THE CONFLICT, THEN TEST WHETHER THE FAMILY CAN SHARE ONE RESTORED ORDER.
